items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: Did you play in that band yourself? Yeah. ... In Charlie Crefft's band? Yeah.

ctx.x: Mostly, mostly both, but we played a lot of, yeah, excursions.

And we played, uh, we played different gigs. It wasn't no steady job. Now, Charlie Crefft's job, Charlie Crefft had this club, this plantation on Market Street. Mm-hmm. In St. Louis? Yeah, in St. Louis. Uh, it was right down the street from the old Book of Washington Theater.
Yeah. Now, Marge wasn't with Charlie Crefft at that time, was it?
